summary: The patient missed the appointment because they did not receive a reminder and subsequently forgot the scheduled visit.
recommended_action: Verify patient contact details in the system and ensure SMS reminder settings are active for future appointments.

summary: The patient missed the appointment due to the clinic's distance and a lack of available transportation on the morning of the visit.
recommended_action: Offer the patient a telehealth consultation or refer them to a closer satellite clinic if available.

summary: The patient missed the appointment due to concerns regarding the consultation fee and inquired about potential discounts for follow-up visits.
recommended_action: Provide the patient with information regarding any available loyalty discounts or financial assistance programs for follow-up consultations.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to high fever and body ache.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment once the patient confirms they have recovered.

summary: The patient missed the appointment due to an urgent, mandatory work meeting and requested an evening slot for future visits.
recommended_action: Offer the patient an evening appointment slot to accommodate their work schedule.

summary: The patient forgot the appointment and stated they did not receive an SMS reminder. They requested to reschedule.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment and verify the patient's contact details for future SMS notifications.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of available local transport options near their residence.
recommended_action: Offer the patient a teleconsultation option or assist in scheduling future appointments during non-peak transit hours.

summary: The patient was unreachable after three attempts as their phone was switched off.
recommended_action: Send an automated SMS reminder and attempt to contact the patient again during a different time of day.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a factory shift change and inability to take leave. They requested Saturday slots.
recommended_action: Update patient profile to prioritize Saturday appointment availability.
